1070|bd6c9aff.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|bd6c9aff.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lad, then mark me--you've found it!

1317|c3ea1f53.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|c3ea1f53.text: You seem confident. Surely you wouldn't mind a test of your skills?

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1646|1d2a2e75.name: Baros Alexston
1646|1d2a2e75.text: Greetings, I am Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind.

2086|4eb20e0f.name: Valstag Ironjaw
2086|4eb20e0f.text: It takes strong arms and brave hearts to keep the town of Menethil safe!

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

256735|8db10840.name: Mivin Shadowweave
256735|8db10840.text: <Mivin gestures toward his wares and back at you again with a smile, but says nothing.>

257597|32ab8342.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
257597|32ab8342.text: Out of the hottest fire comes the strongest steel.

257597|879e41ad.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
257597|879e41ad.text: To give light, one must burn.

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

258098|8fca8484.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

258203|a955ba26.name: Hervdana Saegrund
258203|a955ba26.text: Welcome to our humble home. Rest by the fire if ye need to dry off.

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

272|c8dcec52.name: Chef Grual
272|c8dcec52.text: Hello, hello!  Welcome to my kitchen, sir!  This is where all of the Scarlet Raven Tavern's finest delicacies are made.  Ah, just smell the wonderful aroma!

2786|c9907ea0.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
2786|c9907ea0.text:
Welcome to Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, $c.  You may look, but do not touch.

Some of the knowledge here is not meant for the...uninitiated.

278|a87776c0.name: Sara Timberlain
278|a87776c0.text: Hello, good sir.  Have a seat, and a meal if you're hungry.  Don't fret if I look busy with my needlework - I'm listening to you...

342|32aa88d4.name: Martie Jainrose
342|32aa88d4.text: Hail, THORVALD!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

5595|e6c8b4c9.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|e6c8b4c9.text: The seers of the old ways, aye I know 'em. The waters of The Forlorn Cavern are where ye can find Eldrun Stormbreaker, $C trainer fer the kin o' the elements.

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

68|8e658029.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|8e658029.text: Shamanism? We don't do that here. Try Ironforge.

7232|e03d94ba.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|e03d94ba.text: Can't ye see I'm busy? This had better be good.

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

109-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

1097-accept.name: Smith Argus
1097-accept.text:
There's a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery.  I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.

You have a sturdy pair on you!  So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand.  We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.

You can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, in the northeast section of town.
1097-accept.title: Elmore's Task

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

112-progress.name: William Pestle
112-progress.text: Do you have that crystal kelp?  I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
112-progress.title: Collecting Kelp

114-progress.name: Maybell Maclure
114-progress.text: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe?  What did he say??
114-progress.title: The Escape

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

13-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-progress.text: We have not time to talk, $N.  The Defias Pillagers are denying the people of Westfall the peace and prosperity they deserve.  Make sure at least 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters have been killed.  That will send a clear message that corruption is not welcome here.
13-progress.title: The People's Militia

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

16-progress.name: Gerard Tiller
16-progress.text:
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.

If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
16-progress.title: Give Gerard a Drink

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

167-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-progress.text: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
167-progress.title: Oh Brother...

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

170-accept.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-accept.text:
I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.

I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.

And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! 

We're a bit shorthanded here, lad, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
170-accept.title: A New Threat

1702-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1702-progress.text: Hello!  Dry times, don't you think?
1702-progress.title: The Shieldsmith

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

184-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
184-progress.text:
You have the deed to my farm??  That's good news!  Some ruffians stole it days ago... I thought it was gone for good!

Please, let me have it.  We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...
184-progress.title: Furlbrow's Deed

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

214-progress.name: Scout Riell
214-progress.text: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang?  If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

2160-progress.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

233-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
233-accept.text:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lad? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
233-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

2928-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2928-progress.text: If this were a race, you would have lost by now.
2928-progress.title: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

3361-progress.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-progress.text:
Oh goodness $N, this town is not well suited for the likes of me.  There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

Do you have my belongings?  If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
3361-progress.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

34-progress.name: Martie Jainrose
34-progress.text: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
34-progress.title: An Unwelcome Guest

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

3861-progress.name: Chicken
3861-progress.text:
The chicken stares at you with dark, cold eyes. It waits for you hungrily.

"BACAAAW!

Cluck...cluck...cluck."
3861-progress.title: CLUCK!

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

469-progress.name: James Halloran
469-progress.text: Hello there, $c. Could I interest you in a pair of boots?  Perhaps some newly cured skins?
469-progress.title: Daily Delivery

47-progress.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-progress.text: Psst!  You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
47-progress.title: Gold Dust Exchange

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

60-progress.name: William Pestle
60-progress.text: Did you gather those candles yet?
60-progress.title: Kobold Candles

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

64-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-complete.text:
My watch!  Thank you so much, kind sir! 

We are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
64-complete.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

78142-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78142-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78142-complete.title: Bewitchments and Glamours

78142-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78142-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78142-progress.title: Bewitchments and Glamours

79008-accept.name: Unknown
79008-accept.text:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008-accept.title: ... and that note you found

79008-complete.name: Unknown
79008-complete.text: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.
79008-complete.title: ... and that note you found

79192-accept.name: Unknown
79192-accept.text: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192-accept.title: Stepping Stones

79192-complete.name: Unknown
79192-complete.text: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.
79192-complete.title: Stepping Stones

79974-accept.name: Unknown
79974-accept.text:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974-accept.title: Wet Job

79980-accept.name: Unknown
79980-accept.text: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980-accept.title: Scramble

79980-complete.name: Unknown
79980-complete.text: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.
79980-complete.title: Scramble

83-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
83-progress.text: I'm running low on linen, $N.  Do you have any for me?
83-progress.title: Red Linen Goods

84-progress.name: Billy Maclure
84-progress.text: Ugh... I'm starving!  Do you have that pie for me, $N?
84-progress.title: Back to Billy

86-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-progress.text:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

Do you have that boar meat?
86-progress.title: Pie for Billy

87-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found my necklace?
87-progress.title: Goldtooth

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

90-progress.name: Chef Grual
90-progress.text: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet?
90-progress.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

91723-accept.name: Hamish Bergwort
91723-accept.text:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
91723-accept.title: Delicate Instruments

91723-complete.name: Hamish Bergwort
91723-complete.text: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...
91723-complete.title: Delicate Instruments

91724-accept.name: Hamish Bergwort
91724-accept.text:
Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.
This is most frustrating, $N. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
91724-accept.title: Delicate Instruments

91724-complete.name: Hamish Bergwort
91724-complete.text: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, $N.
91724-complete.title: Delicate Instruments

91725-complete.name: Blixie Fitzwink
91725-complete.text: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!
91725-complete.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91732-accept.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-accept.text: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732-accept.title: Good Steel

91732-complete.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-complete.text: Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.
91732-complete.title: Good Steel

91732-progress.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-progress.text: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732-progress.title: Good Steel

91733-accept.name: Ormin Pelford
91733-accept.text:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.
Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort - do you think you could find them for me?
91733-accept.title: Downstream

91733-complete.name: Ormin Pelford
91733-complete.text: You look a bit damp, $N. Sorry about that. But thank you for retrieving the supplies.
91733-complete.title: Downstream

91751-complete.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-complete.text: Excellent work collecting these pelts, $c. You have a real talent for hunting.
91751-complete.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91751-progress.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-progress.text: Any luck with those wolf pelts?
91751-progress.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91899-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91904-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91904-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91904-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91904-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92415-complete.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
92415-complete.text:
Heartweaver? Heartweaver...

Oh! Little Jeremy Heartweaver. He was brought in years ago after the attack on Lordaeron. Lost both of his parents in the attack, poor thing.

He was actually adopted not too long ago by a sweet woman out in Duskwood.
92415-complete.title: Remember That I Love You

92415-progress.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
92415-progress.text: What is it, $N? What are you looking for?
92415-progress.title: Remember That I Love You

92744-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-complete.text: I see... these gills appear to be healthy, for now. But we must not be complacent.
92744-complete.title: Murloc Gills

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

92745-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92745-accept.text:
The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.
The Defias have seized the mines of Westfall and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.
92745-accept.title: The State of the Mines

92745-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92745-complete.text: Well done, $N. But I fear the source of the poison may lie somewhere else...
92745-complete.title: The State of the Mines

92747-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92747-accept.text:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, $N, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747-accept.title: Moonbrook Espionage

92748-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92748-accept.text:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748-accept.title: Explosive Consultation

92749-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92749-accept.text:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...
92749-accept.title: A Dynamite Plan

92749-complete.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92749-complete.text: This is a great start! Now to tie it all together... and add a little extra zing...
92749-complete.title: A Dynamite Plan

92750-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92750-accept.text:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750-accept.title: Detonation at a Distance

92752-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92752-accept.text: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
92752-accept.title: Explosive Consultation

92753-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92753-accept.text:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
92753-accept.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92753-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92753-complete.text: So you found the forge, and planted the bomb... only one thing remains to be done.
92753-complete.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92819-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92819-accept.text: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.
92819-accept.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92819-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92819-complete.text: I don't know what to say, $N. To think that Stormwind would put their military ambitions over the livelihood of their people...
92819-complete.title: Destruction in Deadmines

94373-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-accept.text:
Aye, the time's come, young $c. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the $c's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373-accept.title: Call of Earth

94373-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-complete.text:
Well done, lad. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. Strength, stamina, patience. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares. 

I'll craft ye a sapta now--accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.
94373-complete.title: Call of Earth

94373-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-progress.text:
Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys--slow and stubborn, like a true $r. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole.

Others may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.
94373-progress.title: Call of Earth

94374-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94374-accept.text:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few $c know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374-accept.title: Call of Earth

94374-complete.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
94374-complete.text:
Ah... $N... the earth welcomes you, even in this frozen land. Bound in body and spirit, you'll walk forward knowing the mountains are your strength, the plains your patience, and the world your essence.

To pass this rite, stand humbly before the earth. The other elements are not so still--they clash and roar. Learn their dual nature, even here among the snow and stone.
94374-complete.title: Call of Earth

94375-accept.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
94375-accept.text:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, $N. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375-accept.title: Call of Earth

94375-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94375-complete.text: Well done! Know this--totems ain't just a mark of yer place among shamans. They're tools, a focus for spells tied to stone, soil, and other elements. As ye grow wiser, more o' the mountain's power will open to ye. The trainers will know when yer ready for more. But for now, take this totem, and let the ground speak through ye.
94375-complete.title: Call of Earth

94375-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94375-progress.text: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.
94375-progress.title: Call of Earth

94449-accept.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
94449-accept.text:
It's been long since ye were last tested, $N. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye. 

Seek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.
94449-accept.title: Call of Fire

94449-complete.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94449-complete.text: Hmm... that elder sent ye, eh? Well, a $c's word is solid, so I'll not argue. That means ye're ready for the next sapta. The sapta of fire. I see it in yer eyes already -- the burnin', the hunger. Ye've tasted power, and now ye want more. But mind yerself, $N. Remember what the stone taught ye. Fire's easy to wield, but harder to master. Know when to hold back.
94449-complete.title: Call of Fire

94465-accept.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94465-accept.text:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame. 

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465-accept.title: Call of Fire

94465-complete.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94465-complete.text:
Ah, me apologies, $N. Didn't spot the Torch in yer hand. An honor to meet ye proper.

Many a wanderer climbs these heights chasin' tales of treasure or beasts, only to find naught but stone and silence. But we know better, don't we, $N?

This shrine holds truths far deeper than the Alliance can fathom. To us, it's a sacred flame that waits to be awakened.
94465-complete.title: Call of Fire

94465-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94465-progress.text:
Greetin's, $N. Ye've made it to the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame, eh? Not many do. Only those well-versed in the $c's path can grasp the secrets this place holds. 

Shame ye came all this way just to be turned back--the climb's no stroll through Dun Morogh. But I'm the shrine's keeper, and I won't be lettin' just any foot trod about.
94465-progress.title: Call of Fire

94466-accept.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-accept.text:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, $N? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.
94466-accept.title: Call of Fire

94466-complete.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-complete.text:
These'll do fine, $N.

Fire ain't just fury and ruin--mark me words. It's life, it's forge, it's the breath o' creation. All things are bound in balance. One force tempers the other, gives it meaning. Without shadow, light's but a glare. Without flame, stone's but cold memory.

Masterin' magic means knowin' when to blend, not just burn. That's true wisdom, lad.
94466-complete.title: Call of Fire

94466-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-progress.text: Aye, I've near all I need for the fire sapta, $N--just missin' the fire tar and the seer's pouch. The tar's carried by Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north. The pouch ye'll need to wrest from a Stonesplinter seer in the southern hills. These ingredients are bound to flame, as all true saptas must be. Their elemental ties make our craft strong.
94466-progress.title: Call of Fire

94467-accept.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94467-accept.text:
The fire sapta's ready, $N. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him.

Strike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.
94467-accept.title: Call of Fire

94467-complete.name: Unknown
94467-complete.text:
A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you.

You place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire. The smoke seems to drift towards the peak of the looming mountain.
94467-complete.title: Call of Fire

94467-progress.name: Unknown
94467-progress.text:
The brazier stands about a third your height, with charred inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch. 

Blackrock Mountain looms in the distance, in clear view to honor from this sacred place.
94467-progress.title: Call of Fire

94468-accept.name: Unknown
94468-accept.text:
Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.

You start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
94468-accept.title: Call of Fire

94468-complete.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94468-complete.text:
By Madoran's beard, yer spirit burns brighter than any torch I've laid eyes on, $N--and that's somethin' to be proud of.

Keep walkin' this path, and the elements'll bend to yer will. Our kin will come to ye for wisdom and guidance. So let me be the first to offer me hearty congratulations--and present ye with yer newest totem. Ye've earned it, flameborn.
94468-complete.title: Call of Fire

94468-progress.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94468-progress.text: Aye, $N? What do ye have there?
94468-progress.title: Call of Fire

94472-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94472-complete.text: Take this and remember, it is sacred.
94472-complete.title: Earth Sapta

94494-accept.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
94494-accept.text:
Long has it been since ye were last tested, $N. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, $N.
94494-accept.title: Call of Water

94494-complete.name: Norric Lochthane
94494-complete.text: The wind's rushin' at yer back, the stone's firm beneath yer boots, and the fire in yer belly's burnin' bright. Aye, it's time ye learned the truth o' water's purity. Yer path's been long, but it's yer spirit that'll carry ye further still. Now, go on, take that first step. The mountain waits for no one.
94494-complete.title: Call of Water

94495-accept.name: Norric Lochthane
94495-accept.text:
If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.

If ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.

Go on then, don't let the river outrun ye.
94495-accept.title: Call of Water

94495-complete.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94495-complete.text:
Aye, I see it in yer eyes, $r. You're wonderin' what kind o' soul chooses to live out here, deep in the Wetlands, with Dark Iron scum lurkin' about and nary a guard in sight. Well, we all have our reasons, love. 

But the real question is, what brings you to our home? Out here at the edge of the falls, I reckon we both know the answer to that.

<Hervdana stretches out her arm, fingers catching mist spray from the waterfall.>
94495-complete.title: Call of Water

94497-accept.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94497-accept.text:
Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.

We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.
94497-accept.title: Call of Water

94497-complete.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94497-complete.text:
Glad ye managed to steer clear o' the Dark Iron. Shame they've crept so far north--makes ye wonder what dwarfkind could do if the clans ever stopped squabblin' and worked as one.

Still, the tides rise high when the moons are strong, and the seawater floods the marsh. It's here that we study our estuary water.

Thank ye for this sacred offering. It marks the beginning of your stage as a vessel--one who seeks the waters' wisdom.
94497-complete.title: Call of Water

94497-progress.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94497-progress.text: I'm nearly ready to send ye off on the rest o' yer tasks. But tell me, have ye filled the skin yet? The ocean brings life, aye--but it carries sediment, minerals, and energies far different from the snowmelt and springwater of the highlands. Where sea and spring meet, there's wisdom to be found.
94497-progress.title: Call of Water

94499-accept.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94499-accept.text:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.
94499-accept.title: Call of Water

95161-accept.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
95161-accept.text:
If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.

If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
95161-accept.title: Remember That I Love You

95161-complete.name: Avette Fellwood
95161-complete.text:
Oh no...

It's nice of you to bring this, but I don't think Jeremy is ready to see it. Matron Nightingale said my little Jeremy hasn't spoken since the attack on Lordaeron, and I don't intend to force him now. Showing him this will only cause him more pain.

Don't look at me like that. I won't hide his past from him, but he needs time to heal. I'll give this to him when he's older. Thank you for stopping by, but I think it's time you should go.
95161-complete.title: Remember That I Love You

95195-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
95195-complete.text:
Your instincts to bring these to me were not unfounded. When Lordaeron fell to the Scourge, many people fled to take refuge here in Stormwind. There are likely few who remain to claim these insignias themselves.

Your duty to Stormwind is commended, $N. I'll begin distributing these tokens to next of kin right away.
95195-complete.title: Bloodied Insignia

95195-progress.name: General Marcus Jonathan
95195-progress.text: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, $N. What is it?
95195-progress.title: Bloodied Insignia

95999-accept.name: Unknown
95999-accept.text:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999-accept.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96056-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96056-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
96056-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96139-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-accept.text:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139-accept.title: The Valor Family

96139-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-complete.text:
This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them.

I'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.
96139-complete.title: The Valor Family

96139-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139-progress.title: The Valor Family

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

96628-progress.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628-progress.title: The Adventurer

96629-progress.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
96629-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96629-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

97894-complete.name: Gorbold Steelhand
97894-complete.text:
Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.

We could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.
97894-complete.title: Business in Auberdine

97920-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97920-accept.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97920-accept.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97920-complete.name: Lee Brown
97920-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97920-complete.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97922-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97922-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97922-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97922-complete.name: Adele Fielder
97922-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97922-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

98197-accept.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-accept.text:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197-accept.title: Spoils of War

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

98247-accept.name: Unknown
98247-accept.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98247-accept.title: Shipping Label

98247-complete.name: Marcy Baker
98247-complete.text:
You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.

When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.

Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
98247-complete.title: Shipping Label

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label

98372-complete.name: Night Watch Guard
98372-complete.text:
The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.
98372-complete.title: An Unfortunate End

98386-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
98386-accept.text:
Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.
98386-accept.title: Alther's Mill

98386-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
98386-complete.text:
The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.

I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, $N!
98386-complete.title: Alther's Mill

98387-accept.name: Marshal Marris
98387-accept.text:
You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387-accept.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-accept.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-accept.text:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
98407-accept.title: Show of Force

98407-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-complete.text:
Quite the armful you have.

While this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, $N.
98407-complete.title: Show of Force

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98459-accept.name: Tom "Half-fish" Wilson
98459-accept.text:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!
98459-accept.title: A Lack of Virtue

98459-complete.name: Bart Tidewater
98459-complete.text:
<Bart unwraps the gift.>

Why that no good, son of a--

Did he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!

I swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--

I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!
98459-complete.title: A Lack of Virtue

98459-progress.name: Bart Tidewater
98459-progress.text:
Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!

Oh? What's that you have there, traveler?
98459-progress.title: A Lack of Virtue

98581-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
98581-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the $c trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98581-accept.title: Archaic Rune

98581-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
98581-complete.text: The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new shamans learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.
98581-complete.title: Archaic Rune

98581-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
98581-progress.text: Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of a $c.
98581-progress.title: Archaic Rune

99130-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
99130-complete.text:
Give me just a minute...

It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.
99130-complete.title: An Enticing Offer

99131-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
99131-accept.text:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.
99131-accept.title: Baited for Success

99131-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99131-complete.text: Poisoned bait? As long as the fish aren't going to eat it, that should work. I'll visit Remy later to pick it up.
99131-complete.title: Baited for Success

99143-progress.name: Lee Brown
99143-progress.text: What did you find? Anything interesting?
99143-progress.title: Bottles and Baubles
